# Retained XI tariff response

Retrieved 15 September 2026 from the official tariff API:
https://www.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/xi/api/v2/commodities/7323930010?filter%5Bgeographical_area_id%5D=CO&as_of=2026-09-15

The adjacent JSON is the unmodified response. It supplies dated XI measure
